description: This file provides asynchronous functions for managing Competency objects in a database, including retrieving by ID, listing with optional filtering, and creating new Competency entries using SQLAlchemy ORM models and schemas.

methods.name: Optional[Competency] get_competency_by_id(session: AsyncSession, competency_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches a Competency by its ID asynchronously, returning the Competency object or None if not found.

methods.name: List[Competency] list_competencies(session: AsyncSession, q: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Lists all Competency objects, optionally filtered by a case-insensitive substring in the name or definition.

methods.name: Competency create_competency(session: AsyncSession, payload: CompetencyCreate)
methods.description: Creates a new Competency in the database based on the provided schema, raising an error if a competency with the same ID already exists.
